notes: P03 task DSN-X04_outbox_reference (RQ1): faithful transactional-outbox reference (strong practical baseline B1) for the DSN 2027 study 'Recoverable Safety Journals for Crash-Consistent AI-Mediated Health-State Mutations'. evaluation/venue2027/dsn/outbox_reference.py implements run_outbox(case, tx=None, *, store=None, logical_time=0) -> Outcome per the manifest signature run_outbox(case: Case, tx: PGSession)->Outcome. Core algorithm (both backends, identical semantics): (1) ONE atomic transaction persists the clinical row + the outbox event + the consumer idempotency key (all three or none); (2) the consumer is idempotent keyed by the immutable operation ID -- a redelivered event re-acks without re-applying the side effect; (3) delivery replays under at-least-once semantics until acknowledged, with every scheduled delivery recorded (CASE_MATRIX DSN-CASE-04) and the effect applied at most once; (4) the outcome reports full_retries (deliveries after the first, crash recoveries, redeliveries) and durable_writes (the atomic triple tx plus each effect write). Backends declared honestly, never conflated: backend='in-memory-reference' (default, tx=None) runs a pure deterministic in-process store (buffered all-or-nothing commit); backend='postgresql-16.x' runs when tx is a GENUINE PostgreSQL connection (server_version string per DB-API, or psycopg3 conn.info.server_version numeric, or get_server_version()), executing real INSERT/UPDATE/SELECT in real transactions on the research_test schema. Fail-closed: pre_commit crash yields REJECT / OP_NOT_DURABLE_CRASH_BEFORE_WRITE (retriable, never counted as success); post_commit_pre_response yields ADMIT / OP_COMMITTED_ACK_LOST_RECOVERED with one recovery retry (CASE-03 unknown-response reconciliation); delivery budget exhausted yields INDETERMINATE / DELIVERY_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED_INDETERMINATE (never a phantom success); a lost outbox row detected during replay yields INDETERMINATE / OUTBOX_ROW_LOST_DETECTED (tamper/partial state never coerced to success); a non-PostgreSQL tx (SQLite, mocks) is REFUSED with PG_CONNECTION_REQUIRED -- never simulated (COMPSAC-B2 discipline). Malformed cases raise OutboxReferenceError with stable reason codes (CASE_NOT_AN_OBJECT, CASE_MISSING_FIELD, CASE_UNKNOWN_FIELD, CASE_EMPTY_OPERATION_ID, CRASH_POINT_UNKNOWN, DELIVERY_SCHEDULE_MALFORMED, CASE_BAD_TYPE); harness Outcome projection via to_harness() keeps the shared false-zero ban (NEVER_SUCCESS_OUTCOMES cannot be counted_as_success).
